---
title: "[第二課：把研究問題寫成一句可回答的問題]{.zh}[Turning Your Question into One Answerable Sentence]{.en}"
---

## [為什麼這件事會出錯]{.zh}[Why this goes wrong]{.en}

::: {.zh}
有人在 askLLM 裡打了「幫我分析這個資料」，勾選 Submit,收到一段內容豐富、
但完全不對題的回覆——它猜了一個描述統計加一個相關分析，剛好都不是使用者真正
想問的問題。使用者接著在同一個問題欄後面補一句「不對，我是想問兩組有沒有差
異」，再次勾選 Submit。可是 askLLM **沒有對話記憶**:第二次送出時，LLM 完全
不知道「不對」是在回應什麼，只會把整段文字當成一個全新、獨立的問題重新回答。
模糊的指令加上單輪限制，結果就是來回猜測、浪費呼叫次數，答案還是對不上。
:::

::: {.en}
Someone typed "analyze this for me" into askLLM, ticked Submit, and got a
long, confident reply — a description plus a correlation, neither of which
was the question they actually had in mind. They then appended "no, I meant
whether the two groups differ" to the same question box and submitted again.
But askLLM has **no conversation memory**: the second call has no idea what
"no" is responding to: it just re-answers the whole text as a brand-new,
standalone question. A vague instruction combined with a single-turn design
means guesswork, wasted calls, and an answer that still misses the point.
:::

## [askLLM 是單輪問答]{.zh}[askLLM is single-turn]{.en}

::: {.zh}
每次勾選 Submit 都是一次獨立、完整的呼叫；沒有前一輪的記憶可以延續。askLLM
內建的防抖機制只在「這次的問題、摘要、persona、語言、system prompt 完全跟
上一次相同」時才會用快取結果，而不是把兩次問題串成對話。應用內建的操作提示
也明講：修改問題前要先取消 Submit 勾選，改好再重新勾選——因為每次改動都可能
觸發新的呼叫。這代表：**提示詞必須自足**,把背景、變項、比較方向一次寫完，
不能指望「下一句再補充」。
:::

::: {.en}
Every ticked Submit is one independent, complete call — there is no memory
of the previous turn to build on. askLLM's built-in debounce only reuses a
cached result when the question, summary, persona, language, and system
prompt are all identical to the last call; it never threads two questions
into a conversation. The app's own guidance says as much: untick Submit
before editing your question, then re-tick it, because each edit can trigger
a new call. The consequence: **your prompt must be self-contained** — state
the background, variables, and comparison you want in one shot. There is no
"I'll clarify in the next message."
:::

## [八組改寫前／改寫後對照]{.zh}[Eight before/after rewrites]{.en}

::: {.zh}
| 改寫前 | 改寫後 | 補進了什麼 |
|---|---|---|
| 幫我分析這個資料 | 連續變項 score 在兩水準的類別變項 group(實驗組／對照組)之間是否有差異？請建議該用哪個 jamovi 分析。 | 結果變項名稱與型態、分組變項名稱與水準數、設計(兩組比較)、要求的輸出(分析建議)。 |
| 這個資料有問題嗎？ | 變項 income 的遺漏比例是多少？我該先用哪個分析檢查遺漏是否集中在特定組別？ | 具體變項名稱、想檢查的現象(遺漏型態)、期望得到的下一步。 |
| 幫我做統計 | 連續變項 anxiety 和連續變項 sleep_hours 之間有沒有關聯？該用哪個相關分析？ | 兩個變項的名稱與型態、關係類型(關聯而非差異)、要求的輸出。 |
| 這個結果好嗎？ | 跑完 t 檢定後，如果 Levene's test 顯著，我該看 Welch 還是 Student 的結果列？ | 已完成的步驟(跑過 t 檢定)、判斷依據(Levene's test 顯著與否)、想決定的具體問題。 |
| 幫我選模型 | 結果變項 satisfaction 是連續的，分組變項 department 有三個水準，該用哪個 ANOVA,以及事後檢定該選哪一種？ | 變項型態、水準數(三組需要事後比較)、明確要求(事後檢定選擇)。 |
| 我要跑迴歸 | 用連續變項 age 和 hours_studied 預測連續結果變項 exam_score,該用哪個迴歸分析，如何檢查共線性？ | 預測變項與結果變項的名稱、型態、數量、分析目標(預測)、想要的額外檢查。 |
| 資料有離群值嗎？ | 變項 reaction_time 的摘要顯示 max 遠大於 mean,我該用哪個分析畫圖檢查是否為離群值？ | 具體變項、觀察到的線索(摘要中的 max 與 mean 差距)、想要的輸出(可執行的分析建議)。 |
| 這兩組一樣嗎？ | 類別變項 pass_fail(通過／不通過)在類別變項 condition(A／B)之間的分布是否有關聯？該用哪個分析？ | 兩個變項皆為類別、各自水準數、關聯類型(列聯表關聯而非平均數比較)、明確要求分析建議。 |
:::

::: {.en}
| Before | After | What was added |
|---|---|---|
| Analyze this data for me | Does continuous variable `score` differ between the two levels of `group` (treatment/control)? Which jamovi analysis should I use? | Outcome name and type, grouping variable and its levels, the design (two-group comparison), and the requested output. |
| Is something wrong with this data? | What is the missing rate for `income`? Which analysis should I use first to see whether the missingness clusters by group? | The specific variable, the pattern being checked (missingness), and the desired next step. |
| Do the stats for me | Is there an association between continuous variables `anxiety` and `sleep_hours`? Which correlation analysis fits? | Both variable names and types, the relationship type (association, not difference), and the requested output. |
| Is this result good? | After running a t-test, if Levene's test is significant, should I read the Welch or Student row? | The step already done (a t-test was run), the decision criterion (Levene's test), and the specific choice to make. |
| Help me pick a model | `satisfaction` is continuous, `department` has three levels — which ANOVA, and which post-hoc test? | Variable types, the number of levels (three groups implies post-hoc comparisons), and the explicit request (post-hoc choice). |
| I want to run a regression | Predict continuous `exam_score` from continuous `age` and `hours_studied` — which regression, and how do I check collinearity? | Predictor and outcome names, types, count, the goal (prediction), and the extra check requested. |
| Does the data have outliers? | The summary shows `reaction_time`'s max is far above its mean — which analysis should I use to plot and check for outliers? | The specific variable, the observed clue (the max-vs-mean gap in the summary), and the desired output (an actionable analysis suggestion). |
| Are these two groups the same? | Is there an association between the distribution of categorical `pass_fail` (pass/fail) and categorical `condition` (A/B)? Which analysis fits? | Both variables are categorical, their level counts, the relationship type (a contingency association, not a mean comparison), and the explicit request for an analysis. |
:::

## [動手做（5 分鐘）]{.zh}[Try it (5 minutes)]{.en}

::: {.zh}
1. 挑一個你正想問 askLLM 的問題，先寫下目前腦中的版本(通常很模糊)。
2. 對照上表，補進四件事：變項名稱、變項型態(連續／類別)、比較或關聯的方向、
   你想要的具體輸出(例如「建議分析」或「該看哪個結果列」)。
3. 把改寫後的一句話整段貼進 askLLM 的 Your question,勾選 Submit。
4. 讀回覆，確認它回答的正是你改寫後的那句話，而不是原本模糊版本可能被誤解
   的方向。
5. 若還想追問，先取消 Submit 勾選，把追問內容也寫進同一個自足的問題裡，
   再重新勾選——不要指望它記得上一次的內容。
:::

::: {.en}
1. Pick a question you actually want to ask askLLM, and write down the vague
   version currently in your head.
2. Using the table above, add four things: variable names, variable types
   (continuous/categorical), the direction of comparison or association,
   and the specific output you want (e.g. "suggest an analysis" or "which
   result row to read").
3. Paste the rewritten sentence into askLLM's Your question box and tick
   Submit.
4. Read the reply and confirm it answers exactly the rewritten question,
   not a possible misreading of the original vague one.
5. If you want to follow up, untick Submit, fold the follow-up into the
   same self-contained question, and re-tick — don't expect it to remember
   the previous call.
:::

## [帶走這句話]{.zh}[One thing to remember]{.en}

::: {.zh}
askLLM 每次 Submit 都是一次全新的獨立問答，沒有上一句可以依靠，所以你的問題
要在送出的那一刻就自己講完整個故事。
:::

::: {.en}
Every Submit to askLLM starts a brand-new, independent exchange with nothing
carried over — so your question has to tell the whole story by itself, the
moment you send it.
:::
